notes.title: Global technical update
notes.notes:
Was updated

 Physics - now you can play with physics  -  dynamite can help you!  Traps with stones and any other heavy objects is working too!
 Sounds - NPC code has been fixed - now cultists are heard only when they near at you, zombies is fixed too - now they make sounds
 Effects - completely reworked blood effects, fixed other effects, reworked shaders, post-processing
 Music - added a great track from D-noise

 Gameplay - changed the balance and added dynamite
[/ list]

in next update will be fixes for game camera
